instructions.question: Does `proposal.value` name a durable job-to-be-done rather than a feature list?
instructions.focus: Reject solution-shaped statements disguised as jobs.

true.what: Outcome-framed job a person hires the product to do
examples: Keep a daily English reading habit without parental nagging
Build a gamified quiz app with streaks

criteria.outcome_framed: States a progress the user wants to make
